paragraphs: Seamless co-op for Bloodborne on PC, in the spirit of Elden Ring Seamless Co-op: up to four hunters make a team, share one world, join each other without bells, signs or Insight, and keep playing together through lamp trips, deaths, boss fights and chalice dungeons.

It runs on Bloodborne PC, the native Windows port of the PS4 game (the game's own code runs on your CPU, its graphics go through Vulkan; there is no emulator in between). The co-op server and everything else it needs run on the players' own PCs.

No game files are included. You need your own copy of Bloodborne for PS4, version 1.09: a decrypted dump of the game folder with the 1.09 update, or the PS4 .pkg files (the launcher installs them). This project is not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or FromSoftware.
